accent.claim: style target only; do not claim exact regional authenticity until tested with a consenting native speaker

style_mix.goal: Blend the useful prosody traits from multiple user-provided reference recordings into one original NOVA voice rather than reproducing any one speaker.
preserve: Tamil vowel length and consonant clarity

consent_policy: Use only original, licensed, or clearly consented reference audio for speaker identity training. Public recordings may inform general prosody/style analysis but must not be used to clone or reproduce a recognizable speaker.
notes: Target listening impression: youthful adult female, Sri Lankan-Tamil-first with light South-Indian influence, natural Tamil/English code-switching, friendly but controlled NOVA system voice.
